title: Daily digest
summary: Every morning, sends your team a digest of yesterday's new rows in one table, in-app and by email.
description: A scheduled workflow that counts the rows added to one table in the last 24 hours, lists up to ten of them and, when the table has an enum such as status, breaks the count down by value. It goes to everyone with the role you choose, as an in-app notification and an email, at the time and time zone you set.

params.name: entity
params.label: Table to summarise
params.description: The table whose new rows the digest counts and lists.

params.name: role
params.label: Who gets it
params.description: The role that receives the digest (every user with it).

params.name: tz
params.label: Time zone
params.description: The IANA time zone the time and the 24-hour window are read in (empty means UTC).

notes: A staff role to receive it.

includes: A daily schedule over one table
An in-app notification and an email to a role
highlights: Counts, the newest rows and a per-status breakdown
